outcome.answer: Shutong Qiao coauthors VaLiDRec, a recommendation framework that creates variable-length semantic IDs from informative native LLM vocabulary tokens, letting ID length adapt to item semantic complexity. It also uses token-set prediction rather than autoregressive ID generation [1]. Qiao and coauthors’ earlier empirical study examines OCR-based text representations for semantic ID learning, but does not focus on variable-length IDs [8].
